article_title: UK has lost more than it gained from Brexit, Andy Burnham says
adaptation_summary: Adapted for level C; emphasis on article-specific comprehension, inference, and concise written responses.

tasks.prompt: What central argument did Andy Burnham make about the UK's current Brexit settlement?
options: It delivered every promised benefit
The UK has lost more than it gained and the deal created needless barriers
It should remain unchanged forever
It immediately returned the UK to the EU
tasks.correct_answer: The UK has lost more than it gained and the deal created needless barriers
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ברנהאם טען שהברקזיט הקשיח לא הצליח, יצר חסמים לעסקים והותיר את בריטניה עם יותר הפסדים מרווחים.

tasks.prompt: What does Burnham's “emperor's new clothes” comparison suggest?
options: The Brexit deal is fashionable
An obvious failure is being ignored or left unsaid
The monarch designed the agreement
EU rules concern clothing exports
tasks.correct_answer: An obvious failure is being ignored or left unsaid
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הדימוי מרמז שאמת ברורה — שלדעתו ההסדר אינו עובד — אינה נאמרת בגלוי.

tasks.prompt: Which commitment forms Burnham's first test for a future agreement?
options: No return to the single market, customs union or freedom of movement
Immediate EU membership without an election
Ending all trade with Europe
Holding a referendum before Friday
tasks.correct_answer: No return to the single market, customs union or freedom of movement
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המבחן הראשון הוא התאמה למצע הלייבור מ־2024: ללא חזרה לשוק האחיד, לאיחוד המכסים או לחופש התנועה.

tasks.prompt: What is meant by the “Makerfield test”?
options: A legal test conducted by the EU
A requirement that an agreement produce tangible improvements in daily life
A vote held only among manufacturers
A measure of farm exports
tasks.correct_answer: A requirement that an agreement produce tangible improvements in daily life
tasks.explanation_hebrew: 'מבחן מייקרפילד' דורש שהסכם יספק שיפורים מוחשיים בחיי היומיום של הבוחרים.

tasks.prompt: Why do critics call the proposed food agreement “rule taking”?
options: The UK would write all EU laws
The UK could align with EU rules without voting on them
The EU would follow British regulations
Businesses would choose whether laws apply
tasks.correct_answer: The UK could align with EU rules without voting on them
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המבקרים חוששים שבריטניה תאמץ כללים אירופיים בלי שתהיה לה זכות הצבעה עליהם.

tasks.prompt: What did Burnham say would be required before major long-term changes?
options: A mandate from the public at a general election
Approval from Boris Johnson alone
A decision by the Lord Mayor
A vote by EU food exporters
tasks.correct_answer: A mandate from the public at a general election
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ברנהאם הדגיש ששינויים גדולים ידרשו מנדט ציבורי בבחירות כלליות.

tasks.prompt: State Burnham's three tests for a new UK-EU agreement.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין את שלושת המבחנים במדויק: עמידה בהתחייבויות מצע 2024, שיפור הסכם הברקזיט המקורי והתקרבות למה שהמצביעים חשבו שהם בוחרים ב־2016, ושיפור מוחשי בחיי היומיום.
expected_points: Respect the 2024 manifesto red lines on the single market, customs union and freedom of movement.
Improve the original Brexit deal and better reflect the perceived 2016 choice.
Deliver tangible everyday benefits under the Makerfield test.

tasks.prompt: In 4–5 sentences, explain the political tension between Burnham's approach and opposition criticism.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר שברנהאם מציג שיתוף פעולה פרגמטי ושיפורים מעשיים תוך הבטחת מנדט ציבורי, בעוד השמרנים ורפורם מזהירים מחזרה בדלת האחורית או מאובדן עצמאות רגולטורית.
expected_points: Burnham frames closer cooperation as constructive and beneficial rather than a reversal of Brexit.
He retains manifesto red lines and says major changes need electoral consent.
Conservatives and Reform argue alignment reopens a settled debate or erodes regulatory independence.

tasks.prompt: Name two agreements expected at the summit and give one claimed benefit of the food agreement.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שניים מן התחומים — מזון, אנרגיה/סחר בפליטות, ניידות צעירים — וכן תועלת נטענת: הפחתת עלויות לעסקים או ירידת מחירים לצרכנים.
expected_points: Two of: food and agriculture, energy/emissions trading, youth mobility/travel and work.
The food agreement is intended to remove post-Brexit checks.
The government says it could cut business costs or lower shopper prices.

tasks.prompt: Summarise Burnham's immediate summit strategy and longer-term position in 4–5 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להבחין בין ההסכמים המיידיים בפסגה לבין הדיון ארוך הטווח; לציין את ביקורתו על הברקזיט הקשיח, את הקווים האדומים ואת הצורך במנדט ציבורי.
expected_points: The immediate summit aims to finalise practical agreements on food, energy and youth mobility.
Burnham argues the current hard Brexit has imposed barriers and failed to deliver enough benefits.
He plans longer-term talks with options ranging from no change to much closer ties.
He rules out major change before the next election and requires public consent.
